prose: A post tests running RAG with a small language model in the browser and shows why small models hallucinate: SmolLM2-360M, Gemma 3 270M and others confidently suggest absurd GPUs for running Llama 70B. It argues retrieval grounding matters for small local models. Basis: the opening of the post.
highlights: Tiny models give confident but wrong hardware advice.
Explores browser-based RAG with a small model.
Retrieval is used to ground the answers.
